propositions: Recursive conftest glob `tests/**/conftest.py` in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to be selected for any nested conftest change, even unrelated sibling fixture trees.

Runtime tracing shows pytest loads only six ancestor conftests per shard (root plus five non-root), not all nested conftests; unrelated trees like `tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py` are never loaded.
Seven proven over-trigger candidates across 97 recent Verify runs consumed 322.6 runner-minutes without increasing coverage.
Per-shard conftest support mapping must match the exact ancestor-conftest closure derived from configured test paths to prevent over-triggering and drift.
A deterministic contract that expands test files, derives ancestor conftests, and asserts per-shard support closure equality must fail closed on missing or stale conftest entries.
